description: A kind=chat agent flow (accepts a conversation as `messages[]`) with the LLM block's `tools_enabled` set. The composed system prompt (Soul/Goal/Constraints) forces a `get_weather` tool call before answering, so a fresh call yields at least one tool-call pause. Used by test_messages.py (the `messages[]` fresh-call path, design F6) and test_relay.py (the agent-over-relay round-trip: adapter -> live server -> back, verbatim).

inputs.messages: list[ChatMessage] — the conversation; the last entry is the current user turn (role in {user, assistant, tool}). `message` (single string) is also accepted and stands in for a one-turn `messages`.
inputs.tools: list[ToolDef] — injected by the CALLER at execute time (not stored on the flow); e.g. the get_weather stub below

outputs.result: the model's final answer after tool results are returned

tools_note: Tools are ENABLED on the LLM block via processor_config.tools_enabled=true; the tool SCHEMAS are supplied by the caller's execute(tools=[...]) call, mirroring how a browser/agent drives the loop. The get_weather stub used by the tests:

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Get the current weather for a location (integration test stub).

authoring: Authored via noukai-mcp: create_agent(kind=chat, slug='agent-tools', system_prompt/goal/constraints forcing a get_weather call), then update_block_config(processor_config={tools_enabled: true, files: {...}}) to enable tool-calling on the block while preserving the composed prompt. The SDK calls the DRAFT version by default (flow.execute/relay default version='draft'), so no publish step is required.
